results.story: The owner changed the factory password; the new build re-salted the factory hash. update-profile must keep the owner's password, not hand back the factory one.
expected: 'root' is exactly: root:*:20350:0:99999:7::: (untouched entry follows the new base)
a 'root' entry exists and no key appears twice

results.title: Empty base file keeps the other files in their roles
results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:2 (positional roles); migrate-profile:401 passes an empty file when the base lacks the database; behaviour fixed in flipperos-btrfs-tools PR #4
results.story: With an empty base, an account identical in the new base and the profile must survive. If awk counts files by their first line, an empty file shifts every role.
expected: a 'root' entry exists and no key appears twice
observed: a 'root' entry exists and no key appears twice -> observed: no root entry

results.title: Account the owner deleted is not revived by a rebuilt base
results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:23 returns the new base's record when the base changed it
results.story: The owner deleted the factory 'user' account. Because every build re-salts the factory hash, the new base's record differs from the old base's and the merge brings the factory shadow record back. passwd/group lines for 'user' do not change between builds, so they stay deleted and migrate-profile's check_db_pair warns about the orphan.
expected: a 'root' entry exists and no key appears twice
observed: 'user' is absent (owner deleted it) -> observed: 'user' is present: user:$y$FAKE-SALT-BUILD-2$factory-placeholder:20350:0:99999:7:::

results.title: Owner password survives when the base lacks the database
results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:27 'if (!ib) return Ol[k]' - with no base record the new base wins
results.story: With no base record to compare against, the merge cannot tell who changed what. Siding with the new base means a factory credential replaces the owner's. Only reachable when the old _stock lacks the file (migrate-profile:401, :220 requires the _stock itself), so this is an edge case.

results.title: Group password the owner set survives an unchanged base
results.basis_source: libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:3-5 says changed records ride along, but mergerec (libs/flipper-accountdb.awk:32-38) takes every non-list field from the new base
results.story: The owner set a group password on 'wheel' in gshadow; the new build did not touch that record. For group databases the merge keeps member lists from both sides but takes the other fields from the new base, so the owner's change is dropped.

limitations: Only libs/flipper-accountdb.awk is executed. migrate-profile's surrounding steps (btrfs send, finalize_accountdbs, check_db_pair, rsync) are not run.
Inputs are synthetic account databases with placeholder hashes, not files from a device.
No result here was obtained on Flipper One or RK3576 hardware.
Passing every scenario does not make a revision secure; it means these scenarios hold.
